verdict.rationale: Moneybird's own llms.txt names an official CLI as one of three channels on its REST API ('the CLI for the terminal'). That is the product's own claim, but it is a single thin mention with no CLI documentation in the pack. Missing for 10: CLI installation and command reference docs, details on auth and AI or agent workflow usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI exists and works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
